overlaps.rationale: A burn injury is skin damage caused by heat, distinct from a bruise caused by bleeding under the skin.
A burn injury is an active heat-caused skin injury, distinct from a scar left after a wound heals.
A burn injury is caused by heat, whereas a sprain is caused by twisting a joint.
A burn injury affects skin or tissue through heat; a fracture is a broken or cracked bone.
A burn injury is the injury itself, whereas a bandage is material used to cover a wound.
